summary: The test suite covers all major functionality requirements but has notable gaps in scenario coverage and edge case handling. Strengths: unit tests are comprehensive for core functions (version parsing, bump logic, changelog generation), error handling is tested, well-organized into unit/integration/workflow layers, proper use of Pester features and fixtures. Weaknesses: CLI wrapper tests minimal (only 2 cases vs. many module scenarios); Act integration tests cover only 3 of 5 commit types (missing 'none' and 'mixed' cases); limited commit message format variations tested; no file permission/race condition/stress testing; fixture file contents not validated. The suite would catch obvious regressions in happy path and basic errors, but edge cases around commit parsing, file handling, and workflow execution under edge conditions are under-tested. Act.Tests.ps1 references and generates 'act-result.txt' correctly but skips scenario variations the unit tests cover.
